requirements.statement: Organizations are hierarchical trees, not flat lists.
Users are linked to organizations; users can be added from organization nodes.
Breadcrumb labels use Chinese menu names, not route codes.
User avatars are stored through MinIO.
A reusable horizontal user avatar/name component shows a hover profile.
A showcase page demonstrates reusable components.

control_seed.controlled_boundary: schema, storage, system APIs, frontend system views and showcase
